divergence: All three runs fail the same way and give the same wrong answer, an earlier-closed device stock purchase. Each surfaced the de-SPAC matter (in scan hits, file-name searches or its own candidate printout) but chose what to read by matter number, treating the highest numbers as the latest deals, and never opened it. The error sits at the first reading stage in every run. Reviews reinforced the number heuristic: T0's review called the higher-numbered series newer, and T1 followed a review listing only later-numbered matters into a second screening; no review named the needed matter. Label notes and T1's declared new stages (scan aggregation) played no role.
